verdict.rationale: The H200 SXM is a data-center GPU, a hardware accelerator with no user-facing product surface where a user's data is shown or analyzed. 'AI-generated insights inside the product' is therefore a category error for this product type. The bundled NVIDIA AI Enterprise/NIM software is a toolkit for building your own generative AI apps (and is tied to the NVL variant), not an in-product insights feature, so it does not make this axis apply.
